content: About IT Expert System: Leading IT Services & Training top of page Skip to Main Content Empower Clients Through IT IT EXPERT SYSTEM, INC IT Training, Staffing and IT Services Provider 847 350 9034 | info@itexps.com About IT Expert System – IT Training & Career Development in the USA IT Expert System (ITEXPS) is dedicated to delivering exceptional IT training, staffing, and consulting services for both individuals and corporate clients. Founded in 2006 in Michigan and now headquartered in Schaumburg, IL, ITEXPS brings over 12 years of expertise, empowering hundreds of professionals with high-value training that helps them secure the right roles and achieve their career goals. ​ At ITEXPS, innovation and continuous improvement guide everything we do. We consistently upgrade our training programs, career support services, and AI-powered agentic workflow operations to keep our clients ahead in both technology and business. Our WIOA Training Grant programs offer career paths in cutting-edge IT, AI, Cybersecurity, DevOps, and management technologies , delivered through live classroom sessions, online learning, or on-site training to fit every learning style. ​ With customized content, flexible scheduling, and tailored solutions, we meet diverse learning and business needs while supporting operational excellence. Share your requirements with us, and we’ll exceed your expectations—without exceeding your budget! 1/1 Our Beliefs Customers define our success Effective training is essential for talent development Talented staff produces quality products, and improve productivity for business Technology is a strong vehicle for Business Strategy Implementation Educating today's students, to build a stronger tomorrow Education, Experience and Expertise - provides job security & rewards Our Vision Be the #1 trusted, and respected Training, Staffing and Solution provider in the Chicago market, and expand our offerings to world-wide market.
